reason: The free one-pager is the only part I would take him up on, and even that I would probably skim and delete. I have had three guys promise to fix my workflow and none of them knew my customers like I do.
objection: No robot talks to your customers still means something new is touching my phone line, and when it screws up it is my name on the truck, not his.
would_change_my_mind: If he sent me that one-pager and it named the exact jobs I lost last month, real numbers off my own missed-call log, and a neighbor I know said he fixed theirs for the $950 without any funny business.
